{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the [[Prince/Legends|title]] of royalty|the [[Prince (Black Bha'lir)|rank]] within the [[Black Bha'lir]]}}
[[File:Isolder-NEGTC.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Isolder]], Chume'da (heir to the throne) of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]].]]
'''Prince''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] title. It was used to indicate the heir of a monarch, such as Prince [[Isolder]]<ref name="TCPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>; or a noble of great power and wealth, such as Prince [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]].<ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> A Prince could rule independently or mediatise to a greater lord. It was also the title of the nobility for members of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], such as Prince [[Isolder]].<ref name="TCPL" />

The [[Crown Prince of Tof]] was the heir to the [[Throne/Legends|throne]] of the [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Crown Prince was [[Sereno]].<ref name="SW107">[[Star Wars (1977) 107|''Star Wars'' (1977) 107]]</ref>  "[[Princess/Legends|Princess]]" was a typically [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] equivalent of "Prince."
